blocks.text: Yeh chapter 2 (Bacteria and Viruses) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, farq, structure ki tafseel, misalein), aik 4 number ka hissa ya 1+3 / 2+2 ke chhote hisson mein. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Explain the position of bacteria in the five-kingdom and the three-domain systems of classification, and write the general features of their cellular organization. (4 marks)
(Five-kingdom aur three-domain classification mein bacteria ka maqam samjhayein aur in ki cellular banawat ki aam khususiyat likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Five-kingdom system: Robert H. Whittaker ka pesh kiya hua, jo organisms ko jame tareeqe se un ki irtiqai tareekh ke mutabiq taqseem karta hai. Paanch kingdoms: Monera, Protista, Fungi, Plantae aur Animalia. Tamam prokaryotes alag kingdom Monera mein hain; baqi chaar mein eukaryotes.

Three-domain system: pichhle das saal mein molecular studies ne five-kingdom system ki sangeen khamiyan dikhayin, aur zyada tar biologists is ki jagah three-domain system chahte hain jo molecular data se zyada milta hai. Is mein bacteria ki apni domain, domain Bacteria, hai.

Cellular banawat: bacteria mukhtalif group hain, sab unicellular prokaryotic. In mein membrane wale organelles, wazeh nucleus samet, nahi hote aur in ki cellular banawat sab se saada hai.

book_ref.quote: This system classified the organisms in a comprehensive way that reflects evolutionary history of organisms

blocks.prompt:
2 Describe the cell membrane and the cytoplasm of a bacterial cell, including mesosomes and ribosomes. (4 marks)
(Bacterial cell ki cell membrane aur cytoplasm bayan karein, mesosomes aur ribosomes samet.)
blocks.explanation:
Cell membrane: plasma membrane cell wall ke bilkul neeche hai; jin bacteria mein cell wall nahi (mycoplasmas aur spiroplasmas) un mein yahi sab se bahar hai. Is ki banawat mein cholesterol jaise sterols nahi. Kuch jagahon par yeh andar mur kar cytoplasm mein vesicles, tubules ya lamellae banati hai, yani mesosomes, jo DNA replication aur cell division mein shamil hain aur respiration ke markaz hain.

Cytoplasm: is mein hal shuda cheezen aur bare structures jaise nucleoid, ribosomes aur mesosomes hain. Is mein cytoskeleton aur membrane wale organelles nahi.

Ribosomes: bohat se cytoplasm mein azad bikhre aur kuch plasma membrane se dheele jure hain. Yeh eukaryotic ribosomes se chhote hain; har aik 70S hai, bari subunit 50S aur chhoti 30S.

book_ref.quote: These are involved in DNA replication and cell division and also serve as respiratory centres

blocks.prompt:
3 Describe the genetic material of a bacterium. (i) What is the nucleoid and its DNA? (ii) What are plasmids and how are they used in genetic engineering? (4 marks)
(Bacterium ke genetic material ko bayan karein. Nucleoid aur is ka DNA kya hai? Plasmids kya hain aur genetic engineering mein kaise istemal hote hain?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Nucleoid: cytoplasm ke beech ke qareeb be-tarteeb ghana hissa jis mein DNA hota hai. Bacterium mein aik, gol, double stranded DNA molecule hota hai. Is ke saath histones nahi hote aur ise kabhi bacterium ka chromosome kehte hain.

(ii) Plasmids: kuch bacteria mein chromosome se bahar gol, double-stranded DNA molecules bhi hote hain jinhein plasmids kehte hain. Yeh khud copy hote hain, cell division se pehle ya baad. In mein aisi genes hoti hain jo bacteria ko na-munasib halaat, maslan antibiotics, ke khilaf mazahmat deti hain.
Genetic engineering mein plasmids ahem vectors hain: yeh chuni hui genes ko bacteria tak cloning ya khaas proteins banane ke liye le jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Some bacteria have circular, double-stranded extra chromosomal DNA molecules, called plasmids

blocks.prompt:
4 Describe the chemical nature of the bacterial cell wall. Explain the basis of Gram's staining and write a note on the capsule. (4 marks)
(Bacterial cell wall ki chemical banawat bayan karein. Gram's staining ki bunyad samjhayein aur capsule par note likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Cell wall: plasma membrane ke gird sakht wall. Is ka asal juz aik munfarid macromolecule peptidoglycan ya murein hai jo lambi glycan (polysaccharide) chains se bana hai jo chhote peptide tukron se jure hain. Is ki miqdaar mukhtalif bacteria mein mukhtalif hai. Wall mein peptidoglycan se jure lipids bhi hain.

Gram's staining: Sir Hans Christian Gram ne banaya. Gram-positive bacteria violet dye rok kar purple ho jate hain; Gram-negative dye nahi rokte aur asli rang mein dikhte hain. Yeh in ki walls ke farq ki wajah se hai: Gram-positive mein moti peptidoglycan tah aur kam lipid, jabke Gram-negative mein patli tah aur lipopolysaccharides aur lipoproteins ki outer membrane.

Capsule: kuch bacteria cell wall ke bahar capsule banate hain. Yeh jelly jaisi tah hai jo colonies ko chipchipa banati hai.

book_ref.quote: It is composed of long glycan (polysaccharide) chain, cross-linked with short peptide fragments

blocks.prompt:
5 What are the functions of flagella? Classify bacteria on the basis of the number and position of flagella. Write a note on pili. (4 marks)
(Flagella ke kaam kya hain? Flagella ki tadaad aur jagah ki bunyad par bacteria ki darja bandi karein. Pili par note likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Kaam: flagella bohat se bacteria ko harkat dete hain; in ka doosra kaam chemical ishaaron ko mehsoos kar ke jawab dena hai.

Flagella ki tarteeb:
1. Atrichous: flagella ke baghair.
2. Monotrichous: aik polar flagellum.
3. Lophotrichous: aik qutb par flagella ka guchha.
4. Amphitrichous: dono qutbon par flagella.
5. Peritrichous: poore cell ke gird flagella.

Pili (wahid pilus): kuch bacteria mein. Yeh ghair-helical dhaage numa appendages hain jo flagella se chhote aur patle hain. Pili bacteria ko mukhtalif satahon se chipkane aur cells ke darmiyan milaap (conjugation) mein kaam aate hain.

book_ref.quote: Many kinds of bacteria have flagella, which enable them to move

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 2.7 mein lophotrichous aur amphitrichous ki tasveerein badal gayi hain; text wali tareef sahi hai: lophotrichous = aik qutb par guchha, amphitrichous = dono qutbon par.

blocks.prompt:
6 Describe the characteristics and importance of omnibacteria, mycoplasmas and spiroplasmas, spirochaetes and pseudomonads. (4 marks)
(Omnibacteria, mycoplasmas aur spiroplasmas, spirochaetes aur pseudomonads ki khususiyat aur ahmiyat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Omnibacteria: sakht, rod numa, heterotrophic, Gram-negative bacteria jin mein bohat se ahem pathogens hain. Zyada tar flagella wale, spores nahi banate aur aam tor par aerobic. Misaal: Escherichia coli; vibrios bhi shamil.

Mycoplasmas aur spiroplasmas: cell wall na hone se baqi tamam bacteria se mukhtalif, is liye penicillin aur cell wall rokne wali antibiotics in par asar nahi karti. Kuch mycoplasmas mammals mein bimariyan, maslan insanon mein kuch qisam ka pneumonia, karte hain; spiroplasmas paudon ki bimariyan, maslan nariyal ki lethal yellowing.

Spirochaetes: lambe spirilla, Gram-negative wall, 2 se 100 se zyada flagella. Treponema ahem spirochaete hai jo syphilis karta hai.

Pseudomonads: seedhe ya mure Gram-negative rods jin ke aik sire par aik ya kayi flagella, mitti aur paani mein. Yeh organic compounds asani se torte hain; kuch autotrophic, bohat se paudon ke pathogens aur kuch denitrification karte hain. Pseudomonas aeruginosa mitti, paani aur kachi sabziyon mein hota hai; aam tor par be-zarar, kamzor logon mein sangeen infection kar sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Escherichia coli is an example of such bacteria

blocks.prompt:
7 Describe the cyanobacteria and the actinomycetes, giving their characteristics and importance. (4 marks)
(Cyanobacteria aur actinomycetes bayan karein, un ki khususiyat aur ahmiyat ke saath.)
blocks.explanation:
Cyanobacteria: photosynthetic bacteria jinhon ne zameen ki tareekh mein fiza ki azad oxygen barhane mein sab se ahem kirdar ada kiya. In mein chlorophyll-a aur madadgar pigments jaise carotenoids aur neele aur laal phycobilins hain. Bohat se heterocysts naam ke khaas cells mein hawa ki nitrogen fix karte hain. Yeh mitti mein mats ki shakal mein, chatanon par lichens mein aur samandar ki tah ke mats mein zyada hain. Ganday paani mein in ki tez growth rangeen blooms banati hai. Aaj ke petroleum ke zyada tar zakheere gale sare cyanobacteria se bane.

Actinomycetes: dhaage numa growth wale bacteria jo na-munasib halaat ke khilaf mazboot spores banate hain. Kuch nitrogen fixers hain jo phooldar plants ki root nodules mein milte hain. Kuch dental plaque karte hain jis mein daanton ka enamel tabah hota hai. Mycobacterium leprae leprosy aur Mycobacterium tuberculosis TB karta hai. Bohat si antibiotics, maslan tetracycline, chloramphenicol, erythromycin aur neomycin, asal mein actinomycetes se mili, aur har saal in se taqreeban 150 nayi antibiotics daryaft hoti hain.

blocks.prompt:
8 Describe the nitrogen-fixing aerobic bacteria and the chemosynthetic bacteria, and explain their role in the nitrogen cycle. (4 marks)
(Nitrogen-fixing aerobic bacteria aur chemosynthetic bacteria bayan karein aur nitrogen cycle mein un ka kirdar samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Nitrogen-fixing aerobic bacteria: maashi tor par ahem group; Gram-negative aur zyada tar flagella wale. Azotobacter is ka member hai; yeh mitti aur paani mein milta hai aur hawa ki nitrogen ko ammonia (NH₃) mein fix karta hai. Table mein yeh group azad aur mutualistic nitrogen fixers likha hai.

Chemosynthetic bacteria: nitrogen, sulphur aur iron ke inorganic compounds ki oxidation se energy le kar apna khana banate hain. Nitrosomonas aur Nitrobacter is mein hain. Yeh NH₃ ko oxidize kar ke energy lete hain aur NH₃ nitrite aur phir nitrate banti hai.

Nitrogen cycle mein kirdar: nitrogen fixers hawa ki nitrogen ko ammonia banate hain; nitrifying bacteria (Nitrosomonas aur Nitrobacter) ammonia ko nitrite aur nitrate banate hain; denitrifying bacteria (Pseudomonas) cycle mukammal karte hain. Yun bacteria nitrogen cycle mein ahem kirdar ada karte hain.

book_ref.quote: They oxidize nitrogen compounds (NH₃) to gain energy

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein likha hai ke Azotobacter nitrogen ko nitrates mein badalta hai aur use nitrifying bhi kaha hai; dono ghalat hain. Azotobacter sirf nitrogen ko ammonia mein fix karta hai; ammonia se nitrite aur nitrate Nitrosomonas aur Nitrobacter banate hain.

blocks.prompt:
9 Explain the role of bacteria (i) as recyclers of nature and (ii) as environmental cleaners. (4 marks)
(Bacteria ka kirdar samjhayein: qudrat ke recyclers ke tor par aur mahol ki safai karne walon ke tor par.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Qudrat ke recyclers: bacteria taqreeban tamam biogeochemical cycles mein shamil hain jin mein zaroori elements organisms aur mahol ke darmiyan aate jate hain.
- Nitrogen cycle: nitrifying bacteria (Nitrosomonas, Nitrobacter) aur denitrifying bacteria (Pseudomonas) ise mukammal karne mein ahem hain; nitrogen-fixing Azotobacter ammonia deta hai.
- Carbon-hydrogen-oxygen cycle: decomposer bacteria murda organic maadda galate hain aur bunyadi kirdar ada karte hain.
- Oxygen: cyanobacteria jaise photosynthetic bacteria fiza mein azad oxygen barhate hain.

(ii) Mahol ki safai: bohat se bacteria organic compounds asani se torte hain aur mahol se aloodgi khatam karne mein istemal hote hain (bioremediation).
- Shehar ka sewage be-zarar cheezon mein badalte hain.
- Petroleum ke hydrocarbons khane wale bacteria tel ka phailao saaf karte hain.
- Sanati zehreele kachre ki bioremediation mein bhi kaam aate hain.

book_ref.quote: The activities of photosynthetic bacteria e.g., cyanobacteria play role in the increase of free oxygen

blocks.prompt:
10 Describe the use of bacteria as makers of useful products and as biopesticides. (4 marks)
(Mufeed cheezen banane walon aur biopesticides ke tor par bacteria ka istemal bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Mufeed cheezen banana:
- Khameeri ghizayen: Lactobacillus jaise bacteria yeasts aur molds ke saath hazaron saal se cheese, achaar, soy sauce, sirka, wine aur dahi banane mein istemal ho rahe hain.
- Chemicals: dawa saazi aur zarai chemicals ki sanat mein bacteria ahem chemicals banane mein sab se ahem hain.
- Antibiotics: kuch bacteria antibiotics banane mein istemal hote hain.
- Chamra: chamre ki cheezon ke liye jaanwaron ki khaal ki tijarati tayyari mein bacteria lagte hain.

Biopesticides: biological pest control mein pesticides ki jagah bacteria istemal hote hain, aam tor par Bacillus thuringiensis, Gram-positive mitti mein rehne wala bacterium. Yeh biopesticides mahol dost hain aur insanon, jangli hayat, pollinators aur zyada tar faida mand keeron par kam ya koi asar nahi.

book_ref.quote: In pharmaceutical and agrochemical industry, bacteria are most important in the production of important chemicals

blocks.prompt:
11 Where is normal flora found in a healthy animal and what does it consist of? Explain why the association of humans with their normal flora is called mutualistic. (4 marks)
(Sehatmand jaanwar mein normal flora kahan hota hai aur kis par mushtamil hai? Samjhayein ke insanon aur un ke normal flora ka taalluq mutualistic kyun kehlata hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Jagah: sehatmand jaanwar mein andar ke tissues jaise khoon, dimagh aur muscle aam tor par microorganisms se khali hain. Satah ke tissues jaise jild aur mucous membranes mahol se musalsal milte hain aur un par kuch microbes baste hain. Kisi anatomical jagah par baqaidgi se milne wale organisms ka majmua normal flora hai.

Banawat: bacteria, kuch fungi aur protists, aur kuch methanogenic archaea; bacteria sab se zyada aur numayan.

Mutualism: dono ko faida.
- Flora ko insani jism mein ghiza, mustahkam mahol, yaksaan temperature, hifazat aur transport milte hain.
- Jism ko vitamins (maslan enteric bacteria se vitamin K aur B₁₂), hifazat kyun ke flora pathogens se chipakne ki jagah aur ghiza ke liye muqabla karta aur unhein rokne ya maarne wali cheezen banata hai, aur cross-reactive antibodies milte hain jo infection rokte hain.

book_ref.quote: are constantly in contact with environment and are colonized by certain microbial species

blocks.prompt:
12 Describe the general structure of a virus: its size, core, capsid, envelope and shapes. (4 marks)
(Virus ki aam banawat bayan karein: size, core, capsid, envelope aur shakalen.)
blocks.explanation:
Size: viruses bohat chhote infection karne wale agents hain jo sirf electron microscope se nazar aate hain. In ka size 20 nm (parvovirus) se 250 nm (pox viruses) tak hai aur yeh zyada tar bacteria se 10 se 1000 guna chhote hain.

Core: beech ka core genome hai jo nucleic acid, DNA ya RNA, se bana hai.

Capsid: core ke gird protein ka khol jo virus ko khaas shakal deta hai. Yeh protein subunits capsomeres se bana hai; in ki tadaad aur qisam har virus ki pehchan hai (herpes virus 162, adenovirus 252). Core aur capsid mil kar nucleocapsid hain.

Envelope: sirf kuch animal viruses mein nucleocapsid host cell se aai lipid wali membrane se dhaka hota hai. Bina envelope ke viruses naked viruses hain.

Shakalen: animal aur plant viruses polyhedron (kayi rukh) ya helical; bacteriophages cubical, icosahedral (20 rukh), helical ya complex (polyhedral sar aur rod numa dum).

book_ref.quote: The central core of a virus is its genome

blocks.prompt:
13 What are bacteriophages? Explain how bacteriophages are used as carriers in genetic engineering to make transgenic bacteria. (4 marks)
(Bacteriophages kya hain? Samjhayein ke genetic engineering mein bacteriophages ko transgenic bacteria banane ke liye carriers ke tor par kaise istemal kiya jata hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Bacteriophages viruses ka mukhtalif group hain jo bacteria par hamla karte hain; yeh sab se pecheeda viruses mein se hain. Escherichia coli ke sab se mashhoor phages T-phages hain. T4 phage ka sar hai jis ke protein capsid mein lamba double stranded DNA hai, aur dum hai jis ke chhe tail fibres use bacterial wall se chipakne mein madad dete hain.

Carriers ke tor par istemal:
1. Matlooba gene bacteriophage ke DNA mein dala jata hai.
2. Phage is DNA ko nishane wale bacterial cell tak le jata hai.
3. Jab virus apna DNA bacterial chromosome mein milata hai to matlooba gene bhi bacterial DNA ka hissa ban jata hai.
4. Aise bacteria transgenic hain, yani in ke genome mein kisi doosre organism ka DNA hai. Inhein ugaa kar gene ki copies aur matlooba protein hasil kiya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Bacteriophages are used as carriers in genetic engineering

blocks.prompt:
14 What are retroviruses? Explain reverse transcription. Write the history of the discovery of AIDS and why the disease is fatal. (4 marks)
(Retroviruses kya hain? Reverse transcription samjhayein. AIDS ki daryaft ki tareekh aur yeh bimari jaan leva kyun hai, likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Retroviruses: animal viruses ka khaas group jis mein HIV hai. In mein RNA aur capsid hota hai jin ke gird lipid wala envelope hai jis par glycoprotein spikes virus ko nishana pehchanne aur jurne mein madad dete hain. Yeh gol aur taqreeban 100 nm qutr ke hain.

Reverse transcription: retroviruses ki sab se numayan khususiyat enzyme reverse transcriptase hai. Yeh reverse transcription karta hai jis mein single stranded RNA se DNA ka strand banta hai; phir enzyme isi strand se DNA ka double helix mukammal karta hai.

AIDS ki tareekh: AIDS (acquired immunodeficiency syndrome) pehli dafa 1981 mein report hui; baad mein un mareezon mein bhi mili jinhein AIDS mareezon ka khoon ya khoon ki cheezen lagi thin. 1984 mein pata chala ke sabab virus hai aur 1986 mein ise Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) naam mila. HIV host-specific hai: bandaron mein barhta hai magar AIDS nahi karta.

Jaan leva kyun: AIDS immune system kamzor karti hai, aur immune system ke baghair koi doosre viral aur bacterial infections se nahi bach sakta.

book_ref.quote: This enzyme catalyses the process of reverse transcription
